seoDescription: Toledo TPS grades 1–9 start Aug. 25, 2025 and finish June 1, 2026. See phase-in, EHSO, K–8 delays, conference days, breaks, exams, official PDF, and ICS.
heroSummary: Toledo Public Schools grades 1–9 start Monday, August 25, 2025; grade 10 reports August 26 and grades 11–12 report August 27. Pre-School and kindergarten phase in August 25–September 3, EHSO starts September 2, and all Pre-School and kindergarten students attend September 4. The last student day is Monday, June 1, 2026.
heroSourceLine: 2025–26 student attendance dates · Reviewed against the official TPS one-page PDF
calendarNotes: Grades 1–9 begin August 25, grade 10 begins August 26, and grades 11–12 begin August 27. Pre-School and kindergarten phase in August 25–September 3 before all students in those programs attend September 4, while EHSO begins September 2. October 17 and March 13 are two-hour delays for K–8, not closures. K–8 students do not attend during elementary conferences October 30–31. Winter Break covers December 22–January 2, and the January 5 inservice day pushes the return to January 6. Spring Break runs April 3–10. High-school exams are December 16–18 and May 28–June 1. The PDF prints two malformed date strings in its Important Dates block, but the monthly grid and duplicate labels clearly support September 4 and June 1, which are normalized here.

customSections.label: How Two Printed Date Typos Were Normalized
customSections.content: The Important Dates block prints “009/04/2025” for the first day of all Pre-School and kindergarten students and “06/012026” for the fourth-quarter ending. Both dates appear correctly in the monthly grid and in nearby duplicate labels, so this page records September 4, 2025 and June 1, 2026 without changing the underlying schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Toledo Public Schools start in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1–9 start August 25, 2025, grade 10 starts August 26, and grades 11–12 start August 27. EHSO starts September 2, and all Pre-School and kindergarten students attend September 4 after phase-in.

calendarFaqs.q: When is TPS Thanksgiving Break in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Thanksgiving Break is Monday, November 24 through Friday, November 28, 2025. Classes resume Monday, December 1.

calendarFaqs.q: When is TPS Winter Break in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 22, 2025 through January 2, 2026. January 5 is a teacher inservice day with no students, so classes resume January 6.

calendarFaqs.q: When is TPS Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Friday, April 3 through Friday, April 10, 2026. Classes resume Monday, April 13.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day for TPS students in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Monday, June 1, 2026. It is also the end of Quarter 4 and Semester 2; June 2 is a teacher workday.

calendarFaqs.q: Why are October 17 and March 13 marked differently for K–8?
calendarFaqs.a: Both are quarter-ending dates with a two-hour delay for K–8. Students attend later than usual; they are not full no-school days.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the official 2025–26 TPS PDF contain date typos?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Its Important Dates block prints September 4 with an extra zero and June 1 without a slash. The monthly grid and duplicate labels make both intended dates clear, so this page normalizes the formatting.
